note: The script asks for the hook text, the name super and one key line (a cross-pollination of children). The other rows are captions only. The end card is typed until the LearnFresh logo is in the repo.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: They don't even realize they're learning.

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: They don't even realize they're learning. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: Bill Donovan / Program Supervisor, Maspeth Town Hall.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: They don't even realize they're learning. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: Bill Donovan / Program Supervisor, Maspeth Town Hall.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Program Supervisor, Maspeth Town Hall> under it.

mg.title: Key line
mg.cue: Key line in the top band as he says it: a cross-pollination of children. 2 s.
mg.use: Put it on at the moment he says it and hold 2 s, in the top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card lines: <q>Learn more at learnfresh.org</q>. No logo before this card.
mg.src: No LearnFresh logo file in the repo yet (brand kit is in Airtable). The name is typed until the logo is added to endcards/learn-fresh/.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:41 after the last line and hold it to the end.
